title: Platform compatibility: FileMaker WebDirect
description: Script steps in scope that do not run, run only partially, or have no published compatibility statement on FileMaker WebDirect. Source: Claris step-compatibility table (fm_spec step_compat, tri-state: Yes/No/Partial).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Steps that Claris marks 'No' fail on FileMaker WebDirect; steps marked 'Partial' are conditionally supported and need the step notes checked.
rule.remediation: Replace or guard unsupported steps for this runtime; for 'Partial' steps read the linked Claris help page notes.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Steps in scope that are not or only partially supported on FileMaker WebDirect
